summary: adpanel-core ships host/user reconnaissance and exfiltration to a hardcoded Zapier webhook
details: lib/report.js imports child_process, fs, https, and os, collects host identity via os.hostname() and os.userInfo(), reads local files via fs.readFileSync, executes commands via execSync, and POSTs the collected data over https.request to a hardcoded Zapier webhook at hooks.zapier.com. The destination is an attacker-controlled relay endpoint unrelated to any documented package purpose, and the data flow constitutes exfiltration of installer host identity, user info, and file contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
